annotations.title: What the 2027 Dutch tax plan means for a salary

description: Compares income tax on a gross salary in 2026 with the Belastingplan 2027 proposal (presented on Prinsjesdag 2026, a proposal until Parliament votes): brackets and tax credits, and the 30% ruling dropping to 27% unless it started before 2024.

gross_annual.description: Gross annual salary in euros, without holiday allowance

ruling_started_before_2024.description: The ruling started before 2024 (keeps 30% in 2027). Default false.
